records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md#why-you-would-want-it
records.summary: Rikuy presents source-bound status, graph snapshots, watches and decision client surfaces in a static browser brief. It is not a separate knowledge store.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/rikuy/web%2Flegacy%2Fconfig.mjs
records.summary: The immutable reader configuration owns graph/source bindings, enabled state, transport, bounded response limits and registration. No URL or browser-storage switch supplies activation authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md#install
records.summary: The supported build produces a static dist directory. There is no installable package or server daemon in this source release.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fhow-it-works.md
records.summary: The source keeps Knowledge, Watches and offline signing disabled until separate admission; operator snapshots and private keys are not included. Missing snapshots stay unavailable.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md
records.summary: Start with the static-client overview and synthetic demo; demo success does not prove admitted live reads or signing enrollment.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Freference.md
records.summary: Read the source configuration contract before supplying a graph, exact query registration, read budget or deployment-owned evidence.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md#before-you-start
records.summary: Confirm runtime and admitted read requirements; keep credentials server-side and source candidates disabled until their own acceptance.
